name: Client programs
summary: Builds and assigns client workout, meal and habit programs, and tracks progress against them. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

build-and-track.evidence: No call counts on disk yet: the variants file named in the build brief is missing. Steps come from the mining spec and the platforms evidence.

covered_by.intake-goals: skill (goals, injuries and schedule read from the client record)
covered_by.assess-baseline: skill (measurements and photos stay in the business's own files)
covered_by.build-from-template: draft (program_templates in settings, into the Programs table)
covered_by.load-to-app: draft (Programs row linked to the client)
covered_by.deliver-to-client: approval (check-in email draft, sent only on approval)
covered_by.log-sessions: skill (sessions logged in the Sessions table by the business)
covered_by.check-in-review: draft (check-in email to clients who have gone quiet)
covered_by.progress-tracking: draft (weekly Progress row from the Sessions table)

crons.name: program-draft
crons.summary: Draft a program row for each client whose intake is complete and whose goal matches a saved template.

crons.name: check-in
crons.summary: Draft a check-in email for active clients with no logged session for the set number of days, and queue it for approval.

crons.name: progress-summary
crons.summary: Write one weekly progress row per active client from the sessions logged that week.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations write to the business's own Airtable base (client, program, session and progress rows) and create Gmail drafts. Nothing reaches a client. Sending a Gmail draft is a live operation and waits for a person.

airtable.covers: client, program, session and progress rows in the business's base

google-workspace.covers: check-in email drafts and their approved send

gaps: Mindbody: the help pages describe bookings, waivers and check-ins, not program assignment or measurements. No Mindbody platform folder exists in the kit, so nothing is mapped for it.
Hapana: named in the mining spec, but no Hapana platform folder exists in the kit, so nothing is mapped for it.
The variants file named in the build brief is not on disk, so there are no call counts and no call-level step evidence.
Renewal and close-out of a program has no mapped operation. Airtable has no documented program lifecycle.
Measurements and progress photos: Airtable holds only text and attachments here, and no photo upload is mapped for this job.
Assessing a baseline, designing a program, adjusting it and habit set-up are coach judgment. The crons do not do them.
Airtable field names are per base. settings.example.json uses placeholder names that must match the client's base before any cron runs.
Both adapters are docs-only until a sandbox base and a Google test mailbox prove them.

evidence.calls: 0 call evidence on disk (variants file missing)
evidence.platforms: airtable, google-workspace and mindbody help pages, from fitness-beauty-client-programs-platforms.json. Airtable and Google Workspace have kit operations; Mindbody has none.
